items.title: Gucci's new 'Made in China' sneaker models break with Italian tradition
items.summary: Reuters wire story reports Gucci is now selling two Primavera-collection sneakers, including Demna's 'Drip' model, labeled 'Made in China' on gucci.com and observed in a Paris store -- a first departure from the brand's all-Italian-manufacturing claim. Gucci says the Chinese partner offered technical capability comparable to past Swiss/Japanese supplier deals for watches and eyewear and denies broader production shift. Berenberg analysts warn of 'tension between provenance and the luxury positioning' Gucci is chasing; consultant Simon Whitehouse says bluntly 'Made in China is not a good look'; Barclays' Carole Madjo links it to a wider price-value debate as Gucci sales have halved over three years. Explicitly ties the story to Demna's Milan runway show today (Sept 25/26).

items.title: 古驰最高降价40%！奢侈品"只涨不降"神话破灭？深度解析
items.summary: Weibo explainer post breaks down Gucci's September 2026 China repricing (Ophidia mini bucket bag cut from CNY12,300 to CNY8,700, GG Marmont to CNY8,100), framing it as the first time a top luxury house has broken the 'prices only rise' convention. Cites Kering's FY2025 -22% revenue and characterizes rival response as split -- LV trimming ~10%, Hermes/Chanel holding firm. Reader angle skews toward viewing the cuts as proof Gucci overpriced itself rather than a savvy reset.

items.title: 古驰包二手能卖多少钱？
items.summary: Weibo secondhand-market post states Gucci bags see the steepest resale discount among major luxury brands, often reselling at only 10-20% of retail even unused; only high-demand styles (Marmont, GG dionysus/'jiushen', 1955, Jackie) hold 30-60% of original value. Explicitly links the just-announced 30-40% official China price cuts to further compressing secondhand valuations, warning collectors that new-season purchases now carry added depreciation risk.

items.title: 익숙한 이름들이 새롭게 쓰는 다음 장! 2027 봄-여름 밀라노 패션위크 미리보기
items.summary: Korean Vogue-adjacent title previews Milan Fashion Week SS27 (Sept 22-28), confirming Demna's second Gucci ready-to-wear show lands September 25 at 2pm, the same day as Moschino's and Marni's sophomore shows under new directors. Frames Demna's sophomore outing as a key test of whether his first-season shift toward flowing, body-conscious tailoring and 90s-2000s Tom Ford-era sensuality can hold audience attention a second time.

items.title: 구찌, 2026 가을·겨울 아이웨어 새 시선
items.summary: Korean lifestyle-press writeup of Gucci's FW26 eyewear campaign, describing portrait-style imagery of models in reflective, solitary moments wearing black acetate frames with double-G detailing and horsebit-accented round sunglasses. Straightforward brand-activation coverage with no critical framing; part of the routine seasonal PR wave rather than organic buzz.

items.title: 비쌀수록 잘 팔린다더니...이제 아무도 안 사, 추락하는 명품
items.summary: Korean community news-board thread on the luxury-sector slowdown singles out Gucci's 12 consecutive quarters of declining sales alongside LVMH's roughly 35% stock drop this year. Highest-engagement comment argues luxury brands lost their mystique once consumers learned goods are largely made by ordinary factory workers rather than artisans, questioning continued willingness to pay premium prices. Thread shows a lopsided 93,732-to-5 downvote/upvote ratio on the top comment, indicating strong pushback/controversy in the reply chain rather than simple agreement.

items.title: Stray Kids リノ「GUCCI」のグローバルアンバサダーに抜擢!活動に期待高まる
items.summary: Japanese entertainment-news aggregation covering Stray Kids member Lee Know's Gucci global brand ambassador role, noting anticipation among Japanese fans for his upcoming Gucci activities. Standard ambassador-announcement amplification piece with positive-only framing, characteristic of the K-pop-driven activation coverage that structurally oversamples positive sentiment in NEA.
